posts.text:
Independence Day isn't just about flag-waving; it's time to look at the reality beneath the surface. True freedom requires a society that actually works for everyone.

If we want to be truly self-reliant, we must face what is missing:

•Economic Disparity: The rich bypass systems and escape fair taxation through foreign deals, while common citizens navigate a maze of corruption and bureaucratic apathy.

•The Education Trap: Schools churn out employees instead of innovators. They teach nursery kids alphabets but neglect financial literacy, business mindsets, practical thinking, and moral values. We are building a workforce tailored for corporate giants rather than independent leaders.

•The Harsh Reality: We top global lists in pollution, corruption, and safety concerns while lagging in happiness, education, and civic sense.


The government doesn't need us, but we need our nation. It's time to stop confusing blind patriotism with the duty to question and rebuild.

We need a nation that is clean, free, and self-reliant—where schools teach kids to build their own path rather than serve as corporate subordinates.


Happy Independence Day. Let’s strive for a freedom that reaches everyone. 🇮🇳❤



#IndependenceDay #NationBuilding #EducationReform #CivicSense #India

What an incredible way to experience campus life at GNA University! ✨🎓

Today’s fireside chat, titled "From Idea to Icon: Building a Brand that India Loves," was nothing short of transformative.

​A massive thank you to the GBS faculty and department for organizing such a mindful, inspiring, and engaging collaboration for the MBA freshers orientation. Even as a 3rd-year BBA student in the audience, the energy and insights from this session hit home in the most profound way.

​The 2-hour podcast-style session gave us a masterclass in entrepreneurship, mindset, and culture:

~​ Mr. Saurabh Munjal (Co-Founder & CEO, Archian Foods Pvt Ltd / Lahori Zeera) shared his incredible journey as the guest speaker. His ethics, mindset, and unique perspective on turning ethnicity and culture into a powerful, loved brand were deeply inspiring. He showed us what it truly means to enjoy the journey of life while creating something meaningful for society.

~​ Ms. Nitika Mishra Khurana (Chief Investments & Operations, Chandigarh Angel's Network) moderated the session with an exceptionally strong, confident, and empathetic presence, driving a conversation that kept us hooked every single minute.

​Reflections from the session:

Listening to them made me realize that success isn't just about a destination—it's about breaking the ceilings we've limited ourselves to, embracing the vibe, and trusting that life often has a bigger, better plan than what we currently envision.

​I left the auditorium feeling inspired to become successful, free, and capable enough to fulfill my dreams, push past my boundaries, and evolve into a better version of myself as I navigate my final year and beyond.

​Here’s to great mentorship, continuous learning, and building iconic dreams! 🚀✨



GNA University 
Dr. Monika Hanspal 
Dr. Sameer Varma 
Dr. Ramandeep Singh Arneja 
Dr. Yuvika Midha 


​#GNAUniversity #GBS #MBAOrientation #LahoriZeera #ChandigarhAngelsNetwork #Entrepreneurship #Inspiration #BrandBuilding #PersonalGrowth #LearningJourney #BBAStudents

Balancing corporate exposure with intentional upskilling—one of the best investments I’ve made in my professional journey! 💼✨

​I am thrilled to share that I have officially completed my summer internship at Digitech Computer Institute, Phagwara. Stepping into this environment gave me a closer look at administrative operations, client communication, and overall organizational workflow.

​A special and heartfelt thank you to my mentor, Payal Ma'am, for her constant guidance, support, and mentorship throughout this journey. Your insights made a huge difference! 🙏

​But instead of letting downtime pass by, I wanted to make every single hour count. Alongside my official duties, I dedicated my time to completing a Digital Marketing Course, adding a powerful set of modern, tech-driven skills to my toolkit.

​Excited to keep learning, adapting, and growing as I take the next steps in my career! 🚀



​#DigitechComputerInstitute #InternshipJourney #DigitalMarketing #ContinuousLearning #ProfessionalGrowth #BBA #CareerDevelopment #GNAUniversity
